description: Ingress of the production Tunnel joutiya-prod-tunnel (remotely managed, connector in the joutiya-prod Compose project, token in /etc/joutiya/prod/tunnel.env). joutiya.ma and www.joutiya.ma still serve the site until their 301 (ANRT validation of aalan.ma); the back-office is on admin.aalan.ma only. Each hostname gets a proxied CNAME to <tunnelId>.cfargotunnel.com.
